additionalRemarks._instruction: Enter any additional remarks concerning this raster volume.

capturedWith._instruction: Add the device used to capture this raster volume.

coordinateFramework._instruction: Add the coordinate space in which this raster volume exists.

dataLocation._instruction: Add the location of the file or file bundle in which the raster volume is stored.

dimension._instruction: Enter the dimension of this raster volume.

name._instruction: Enter a descriptive name of this raster volume preferably matching the filename.

numberOfPlanes._instruction: Enter number of planes in this raster volume.

voxelSize._instruction: Enter the physical voxel size for this raster volume (in x,y,z order).
